name: Reika
source:
A cool beauty hailed as the strongest Sword Saint.

She has lived her life solely for the sword, and her power is such that she can single-handedly defeat even disaster-class monsters. She travels the world, both for training and to save the weak.

She trusts Astrain, the Valkyrie who grants her blessings.
